0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East, on a four-game winning streak and 6-4 in their last ten) host the Los Angeles Lakers (9-2, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West, on a five-game winning streak and 8-2 in their last ten). Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), all listed as out, while Los Angeles is missing Luka Doncic (back soreness) and has Quentin Grimes (finger) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series and split their 2025-26 meetings 1-1, and the most recent meeting was a 141-116 Lakers win in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
